newsitem.title: USA: Platinum hopes to see new Eagle soar - J Matthey.
newsitem.headline: Platinum hopes to see new Eagle soar - J Matthey.

text.p: The new platinum collector's proof version of the Eagle coin being sold by the U.S. Mint from early June will consume just under 40,000 ounces of platinum, but a bullion version for investors could consume much more, Jeremy Coombes, general manager of Johnson Matthey's precious metals division, said.
"It's not unreasonable to suppose 100,000 ounces of production, and possibly more," Coombes said during the company's presentation on platinum group metals in New York Monday.
Much will depend on how well demand for the bullion coin turns out, Coombes said.
The Mint confirmed the collector's proof coin was tentatively due to launch June 6, but no date was fixed for the bullion coin's appearance.
